lesson-intro.text: Long ago, ships like this crossed cold northern seas with one striped sail and a row of shields along the side. See the scroll curl at the prow, then sail yours.

hull-top.text: A longship is one long curve. From the stern's tip, dip low and sweep up the tall prow.

scroll.text: The prow ends in a scroll. Curl the line around itself, like a cinnamon roll.

hull-bottom.text: Back at the stern, draw the keel: a deeper curve underneath, all the way to the prow.

shields.text: Five round shields hang along the side. Draw them in a row that follows the curve.

mast.text: The mast stands in the middle of the ship. Draw a short post and leave room for the sail.

sail.text: The sail is wide, with bulging sides. Draw its outline, then the mast's tip above it.

stripes.text: Four lines from top to bottom split the sail into five stripes.

color-red.text: Color three stripes and three shields red.

color-cream.text: Color the two stripes in between cream.

color-yellow.text: The last two shields are yellow.

lesson-outro.text: Five shields, five stripes, one proud scroll. Your longship is ready to explore.
